findings.title: Public functions renamed and moved with no compatibility aliases or test updates
findings.body: `mark_failed_threshold` is now `try_incident_threshold` in a new module. `create_issue_platform_occurrence` is now `create_incident_occurrence`. `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, `HUMAN_FAILURE_STATUS_MAP` and `SINGULAR_HUMAN_FAILURE_MAP` moved to `incident_occurrence`, and `SimpleCheckIn` moved to `types`. All of these are gone from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed`, and the PR touches only four files with no test changes. Any other importer or `mock.patch('sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.<name>')` target, including existing mark_failed tests, will fail with ImportError or AttributeError. Update the remaining callers and tests, or re-export the old names.

findings.title: Copied config with display schedule_type is computed but never used
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` builds `config = monitor.config.copy()` and swaps in the human-readable `schedule_type`. The returned dict then uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` instead of `config`, so the substitution is dead code and the raw value is sent. This bug was carried over unchanged in the move; the refactor is a chance to fix it.
